Republic's]] [[D-Squad/Legends|D-Squad]] attempted to '''escape''' from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Abafar/Legends|Abafar]] so that they could return the [[Encryption module/Legends|encryption module]] to the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. ==Prelude== In [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], [[D-Squad/Legends|D-Squad]]—consisting of [[Droid/Legends|droids]] [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]], [[QT-KT/Legends|QT-KT]], [[M5-BZ/Legends|M5-BZ]], [[U9-C4/Legends|U9-C4]], and [[WAC-47/Legends|WAC-47]] and led by [[Zilkin/Legends|Zilkin]] [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Meebur Gascon/Legends|Meebur Gascon]]—undertook a [[Mission to steal a Separatist encryption module/Legends|mission]] to [[Aut-O/Legends|Aut-O's]] [[Aut-O's flagship/Legends|flagship]], in order to steal an [[Encryption module/Legends|encryption module]] from the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|separatists]]. On their way back to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], their [[Maxillipede shuttle/Legends|ship]] encountered [[Comet/Legends|comets]], and suffered severe damage, forcing them to crash-land on the remote [[Planet/Legends|world]]. ==The Escape== ===Finding Pons Ora=== After a short discussion, the squad started a journey, in order to find a [[Starship/Legends|ship]], or at least a town. Colonel Gascon emptied his bottle and threw it away. They found a wrecked ship with several [[Death/Legends|dead]] bodies and destroyed droids. Gascon started to lose his mind, saying he would commit suicide when finding the bottle he threw away some time earlier. With Gascon having tempers and WAC announcing himself as a unofficial leader, eventually the squad split into two groups: R2, BZ, QT and C4 continued their journey, while WAC stayed with Gascon. The Colonel was about to give up the hope, when a herd of [[Void Strider|flightless birds]] crossed their way. Following the instincts of the native animals, Gascon and WAC grabbed two of the creatures, which transported them to the city of [[Pons Ora/Legends|Pons Ora]], where the other members of the D-Squad were already present. Gascon was so happy he found a [[City/Legends|city]], and [[Water/Legends|water]], that he made WAC a [[Corporal/Legends|corporal]]. ===Capture of the shuttle=== {{Quote|Yes, we do have a new mission: stop the Separatist from blowing up that cruiser.''"
"''I'll cover you and clear the way, Colonel. You all head strait to the shuttle; I'll take care of those clankers.''"
"''Sounds like a good plan. You soldiers ready to get dangerous?|Colonel Gascon and Gregor discussing the plan with D-Squad|{{TCW|Missing in Action}}}} [[File:GregorHoldsBackTheTide-MIA.png|thumb|left|250px|Gregor singlehandedly covers D-Squad's escape]] Later on, the squad found [[Gregor/Legends|Gregor]], a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commando]] working in Pons Ora as a dishwasher who was suffering from [[Amnesia/Legends|amnesia]], after going M.I.A at the [[Battle of Sarrish/Legends|Battle of Sarrish]]. He couldn't remember him ever fighting in the Galactic Republic. D-Squad saw him as there only chance of escaping Abafar so they helped Gregor regain his memory and was recruited by them back into the Republic. Gregor and D-Squad made it to the droid base where they were loading [[Rhydonium/Legends|Rhydonium]] into a heavily guarded [[Nu-class attack shuttle/Legends|Nu-class attack shuttle]] intending to blow up a [[Renown/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] stationed above the planet. With Gregor providing covering fire, D-Squad made its way towards the shuttle with Gregor intending to meet them there. On their way, a Rhydonium canister was shot and exploded, knocking over WAC-47 and M5-BZ with Colonel Gascon in him. WAC got up and ran to the shuttle but Gascon was left stranded with the knocked over M5-BZ. Gregor told WAC to start up the shuttle while he went back to retrieve Gascon and M5-BZ. While the two made their way to the shuttle, Gregor held off the approaching droids, getting pinned down behind a pile of crates. While D-Squad insisted that they could swing back and pick up Gregor, Gregor declined, saying that he promised he would find another way home. As D-Squad escapes, Gregor makes a final stand against the approaching droids, shooting and detonating cans of Rhydonium. As the shuttle flies off, Gregor takes out another canister of the volatile substance, causing the compound to go up in a large fireball. With Gregor's fate unknown, Colonel Gascon says that they will bring Gregor's story back to the Republic and watch for his possible return. ==Appearances== *{{TCW|A Sunny Day in the Void}} {{1st}} *{{TCW|Missing in Action}} *{{TCW|Point of No Return (The Clone Wars)}} {{Flash}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |es=Escape de Abafar/Leyendas }} {{DEFAULTSORT:Abafar, escape from}} [[Category:Battles of Abafar]] [[Category:Battles of the Clone Wars]]
